OUR STORY & PROMISE

About TajMahal.City

We are local Agra natives and certified heritage guides who believe visitors deserve genuine hospitality, transparent pricing, and zero commercial harassment.

For decades, visiting the Taj Mahal has been plagued by unverified touts, commission-driven souvenir detours, and inflated middleman booking platform fees. We created TajMahal.City to provide an honest, locally operated alternative.

When you book through TajMahal.City, you deal directly with licensed tourism professionals based on Fatehabad Road, Agra. We take pride in our city's Mughal history and ensure your memories are focused on wonder, architecture, and photography.
